svg.title: Small blocks & rows
svg.desc: Four 9 by 9 metre small-block modules; four 6 by 9.5 metre row dwellings, each with a 6 by 10 metre garden. Source claims: building-rows. Building massing, facade rhythms, stair-room sizes, external stair geometry, trees and context placement are assistant illustration assumptions. Schematic heights: slab 12 m, point block 18 m, small block 6 m, row house 6 m, detached eaves 3.2 m with 1.6 m roof rise and 0.45 m overhang. Entrance gallery depth 1.6 m and level 3 m; gallery canopy underside 5.55 m; stair and guard details are illustrative. TKK supplies footprint dimensions and schematic stair positions, not these heights or core sizes. Trees 5 m, people 1.75 m; car body 5 × 1.8 m. Context pads do not establish parking, access or setback requirements.
